reason: The scrape needs to be part of the body model before its response can be followed; this is the only available action.
expectation: I expect the model to show the scraped hand and reveal a way to limit the leak.

effect: The scrape has broken the skin barrier and damaged tiny vessels; the body’s own platelets are available to respond.
reaction: The distinction between a local injury and the rest of the hand continuing to work is useful.
reason: Platelets are the only offered combination and seem relevant to limiting the leak.
expectation: I expect the platelets to gather at the damaged vessels and begin limiting bleeding.

effect: The platelet plug limits the leak, but the skin still needs repair.
reaction: The distinction between stopping a leak and rebuilding skin is clear.
reason: Clotting proteins are the only offered combination and may strengthen the plug.
expectation: I expect the clotting proteins to help stabilize the plug, though the skin will still need repair.

effect: The fibrin mesh reinforces the platelet plug, temporarily sealing the leak while the skin still needs rebuilding.
reaction: The distinction between a temporary seal and a living barrier makes the next goal clear.
reason: Cleanup cells are the only offered combination and seem suited to preparing the damaged site.
expectation: I expect the cleanup cells to remove damaged material and prepare the site for repair.

effect: Cleanup cells deal with debris and microbes and influence repair, leaving the site ready to rebuild rather than fully repaired.
reaction: The overlapping roles of defense, cleanup and repair are interesting, though the chapter ends before rebuilding happens.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reinforcing the platelet plug was most worthwhile because it showed how a temporary seal differs from rebuilt skin.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the scrape was mostly setup, with only one available action.

surprise.text: I was interested that cleanup cells also send signals influencing repair, so cleanup and rebuilding overlap.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although every combination was the only available gameplay option.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the living skin barrier is rebuilt after the temporary seal and cleanup, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
